| Volume unit | Å³ per conventional unit cell |

Composition-specific record for synthetic run 5K2667. The material formula preserves the article's measured Mg0.88Fe0.10Al0.14Si0.90O3 composition; the site-assigned form is (Mg0.88Fe3+0.065Fe2+0.035Al0.03)(Al0.11Si0.90)O3. The stored diffraction structure is the official deposited 4.2 GPa, 293 K Pbnm refinement with Z=4. Its normalized occupancies give Mg0.88Fe0.09Al0.13Si0.90O3, so it is a refinement model for the same specimen and not a replacement analytical composition. The EOS V0 values are separately fitted zero-pressure conventional-cell extrapolations. The authors report BM2 and BM3 as equally acceptable within uncertainty and do not designate a preferred fit; record ordering follows Table 1 and is not a scientific preference.

## Observation datasets

### mg088fe010al014si090o3\_bridgmanite\_fu\_2024\_table\_s1\_cif\_pv

- **Description:** All 22 recoverable room-temperature Fe10-Al14 bridgmanite compression observations from Online Materials Table S1 and deposited CIF blocks P1-P22.
- **Kind:** single\_crystal\_pressure\_volume\_lattice\_parameters
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Fu; Chariton; Zhang; Okuchi; Prakapenka; Lin
    - **Year:** 2024
    - **Title:** Single-crystal X-ray diffraction on the structure of (Al,Fe)-bearing bridgmanite in the lower mantle
    - **Source:** American Mineralogist Online Materials
    - **Volume:** 109
    - **Locator:** Table S1 and 8969fu.cif
    - **DOI:** 10.2138/am-2023-8969
- **Source location:** Official deposit AM-24-58969, 8969\_supp.pdf Table S1 and 8969fu.cif blocks data\_P1 through data\_P22
- **Associated EOS records:** mg088fe010al014si090o3\_bridgmanite\_fu\_2024\_bm2\_1; mg088fe010al014si090o3\_bridgmanite\_fu\_2024\_bm3\_2
- **Uncertainty:**
    - **Parenthetical values:** Online Materials Table S1 explicitly defines all parenthetical pressure and lattice uncertainties as 1 sigma; CIF cell-volume uncertainties are crystallographic standard uncertainties.
    - **Temperature:** Every deposited CIF block reports 293 K without a temperature uncertainty.
    - **Covariance:** No observation-level covariance matrix is published.
- **Notes:** Table S1 and the CIF report the same 22 pressure states. Separate columns preserve the 7.1 GPa last-digit lattice differences and the conflicting lattice uncertainties at 39.3, 41.8, and 50.1 GPa. The CIF supplies the conventional-cell volume and its uncertainty; no volume is printed in Table S1. The article states that weighted P-V data were fitted but does not publish the row-wise Au calibrant measurements, the exact EosFit weight configuration, or a numerical table for both individual platelet volume series shown in Figure S2.

[Observation resource](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/datasets/mg088fe010al014si090o3-bridgmanite-fu-2024-table-s1-cif-pv.csv)
— SHA-256 `c735c80ede486b5ab85b755f1ab450a56e20864b41f7adeb2e2798e818090fff`.
